card.name: Linking words before a repeated or alternate item
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, or, a comma, another, same or other, placed where a second item of the same kind comes next. Most often in hypersensitivity lists after a drug name, and in phrases about using the same thing again.

card.writes: It suppresses words about copying, mimicking and duplicating, so it seems to steer away from those words after linking words.
